_comment: The DMG window, in points from its top-left corner. dmgbuild-settings.py places the icons from it; make-background.swift draws the arrow between the app and Applications from the same positions and refuses a layout whose icons or labels fall outside the window. verify-dmg checks the built .DS_Store against it. The image is taller than the window: Finder's title bar takes some of the window's height, and the spare plain strip at the bottom absorbs it.

note.text: Opening it for the first time? Read Me First explains the one-time step.
